card.name: Inside drug names before final syllable
card.fires_on: A middle piece of a longer drug name, right before the last syllable (such as ENC in BAVENCIO, atas in velpatasvir, at in dabigatran). It fires in drug-label text when the name is repeated after its first mention.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: The middle piece of an all-capital brand name, just before the ending.

modes.label: Generic names
modes.description: A middle piece of a lowercase generic drug name, just before the ending.
modes.example: Administer dabig<<at>>ran etexilate capsules twice daily.

card.writes: It suggests the next piece is a short name ending (like izzo, unal, acio), not a common word.
card.plain: It marks the spot partway through a long drug name where only the last syllable remains.
